6aa098c1449756fdd00e3c2e07b457e1.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders))
6aa098c1449756fdd00e3c2e07b457e1.rewritten_query:
WITH avg_order AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_amount) as avg_amount FROM orders
)

FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
CROSS JOIN avg_order ao
WHERE o.total_amount > ao.avg_amount
GROUP BY u.id

WITH user_data AS (
    SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'john@example.com'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = user_data.id) as order_count,
    o.total_amount, 
    oi.product_name 
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.user_id = (SELECT id FROM user_data)
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as orders_count, SUM(total_amount) as total_revenue
                FROM orders
                WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
                GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
                ORDER BY date;
                SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) as user_orders, SUM(o.total_amount) as user_spent
                FROM users u
                LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
                WHERE o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' OR o.created_at IS NULL
                GROUP BY u.id, u.name
                HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 0
                ORDER BY user_spent DESC
                LIMIT 10;

52622c4672189a1e8af021d8ac63c222.query:
SELECT schemaname, tablename, attname, n_distinct, correlation
                FROM pg_stats
                WHERE tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')
                ORDER BY tablename, attname;
                SELECT indexname, tablename, indexdef
                FROM pg_indexes
                WHERE schemaname = 'public'
                AND tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items');
                SELECT relname, n_tup_ins, n_tup_upd, n_tup_del, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup
                FROM pg_stat_user_tables
                WHERE relname IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items');
52622c4672189a1e8af021d8ac63c222.rewritten_query:
WITH table_list AS (
    SELECT oid, relname 
    FROM pg_class 
    WHERE relname IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')
    AND relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public')
)
SELECT 
    'stats' as source_type,
    s.schemaname,
    s.tablename,
    s.attname,
    s.n_distinct,
    s.correlation,
    NULL as indexname,
    NULL as indexdef,
    NULL as n_tup_ins,
    NULL as n_tup_upd,
    NULL as n_tup_del,
    NULL as n_live_tup,
    NULL as n_dead_tup
FROM pg_stats s
WHERE s.tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'indexes' as source_type,
    i.schemaname,
    i.tablename,
    NULL as attname,
    NULL as n_distinct,
    NULL as correlation,
    i.indexname,
    i.indexdef,
    NULL as n_tup_ins,
    NULL as n_tup_upd,
    NULL as n_tup_del,
    NULL as n_live_tup,
    NULL as n_dead_tup
FROM pg_indexes i
WHERE i.schemaname = 'public'
AND i.tablename IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'statistics' as source_type,
    'public' as schemaname,
    t.relname as tablename,
    NULL as attname,
    NULL as n_distinct,
    NULL as correlation,
    NULL as indexname,
    NULL as indexdef,
    t.n_tup_ins,
    t.n_tup_upd,
    t.n_tup_del,
    t.n_live_tup,
    t.n_dead_tup
FROM pg_stat_user_tables t
WHERE t.relname IN ('users', 'orders', 'order_items')
ORDER BY tablename, source_type, attname;
